task_completion.description: The 'Blobs' sample image is opened in Fiji.
task_completion.visual_evidence: An image window titled 'blobs.gif' or 'Blobs' is visible within the Fiji application.

task_completion.description: The Fiji Macro Recorder is opened to capture the workflow.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A window titled 'Recorder' is visible, showing recorded commands as the agent performs actions.

task_completion.description: Background subtraction is performed with a rolling ball radius of 50 pixels.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Subtract Background' dialog box is seen with 'Rolling ball radius' set to 50, or the Recorder shows: run("Subtract Background...", "rolling=50").

task_completion.description: A median filter with a radius of 2 pixels is applied.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Median...' filter dialog is seen with 'Radius' set to 2, or the Recorder shows: run("Median...", "radius=2").

task_completion.description: Otsu thresholding is applied to segment the image.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Threshold' dialog is visible with 'Otsu' selected in the dropdown, or the Recorder shows: setAutoThreshold("Otsu").

task_completion.description: The recorded macro is saved to the specific path ~/Fiji_Data/results/macros/clean_and_segment.ijm.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'Save As' dialog or a file explorer window shows the file being saved as 'clean_and_segment.ijm' in the directory /home/ga/Fiji_Data/results/macros/.

integrity.description: The agent used the Fiji GUI menus and dialogs rather than just writing a script manually in a text editor.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the agent clicking through 'Process' or 'Plugins' menus and interacting with Fiji dialog boxes.

integrity.description: The macro content was generated by the Recorder during live interaction.
integrity.visual_evidence: The 'Recorder' window populates with text dynamically as the agent interacts with the image.

integrity.description: The agent did not use the terminal to create the file via 'echo' or 'touch' commands.
integrity.visual_evidence: The file creation is seen through Fiji's internal 'Save' or 'Create Macro' interfaces.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The macro must contain exactly: run("Subtract Background...", "rolling=50"), run("Median...", "radius=2"), and setAutoThreshold("Otsu"). The final file must be named 'clean_and_segment.ijm' and located in /home/ga/Fiji_Data/results/macros/. The 'Blobs' image is a standard Fiji sample found under File > Open Samples > Blobs.
